typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style CivicAmount.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style CivicBreak.

recognitionRules: Use Verdana body text and Trebuchet headings for comfortable document reading.
Open with the proposed case before budget and delivery detail.
Separate intended benefits from evidence already available.
Keep participant activity, staffing and evaluation in distinct sections.
Use teal budget/delivery table headers with white labels, pale rows and black major titles.

principles: Make the invitation warm and the practical details exact.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Make a story you can share. Build the conditions that let people take part.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid speaking for an entire community or implying confirmed attendance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Come for the part that interests you; here is what to expect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use PRINT STORIES TOGETHER in Trebuchet with three short uneven lines suggesting printed text. Avoid a book or charity seal.
invariants: Use Verdana body text and Trebuchet headings for comfortable document reading.
Open with the proposed case before budget and delivery detail.
Separate intended benefits from evidence already available.
adaptations: A funder summary may condense delivery detail but retains the proposed status.
A participant invitation replaces funding language with practical choices.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Trebuchet MS is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Verdana is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
